metric: mean of participant Brier scores; secondary group MAE/logloss and row-count plus group event diagnostics
timing: Prediction precedes each current choice. Current lottery information is available; feedback availability is given only if block instructions announce it or an earlier trial revealed it. Previous choice and observed feedback from the same block are allowed; current choice, current outcomes, future trials and response time are prohibited.
calibration: No participant-specific fitted calibration. Online historical choices/visible outcomes are allowed identically for all models, beginning with neutral prior 0.5; history resets at every block.
groups: SPLITS.json; whole participants stratified by experiment
eligibility: All source new-experiment rows with finite declared inputs and binary choices; older Erev comparison observations excluded. No source optimal-choice label or supplied previous-outcome transformation used.
baseline_families: regularized polynomial logistic with identical full input budget
selection: Smallest parameter count within 1% of best whole-participant development Brier; >=5 adaptive hypotheses, continue until two substantive no-gain outcomes after minimum. No confirmation feedback.
exposure: Header and lottery design values inspected, no response values printed before freezing. Original source publishes aggregate outcome patterns; corpus is source aware.
